03 / 09

Plans for
Santa Marta:

SANTA MARTA · COLOMBIA

I'm going to travel to Santa Marta during my next vacation.

I'm going to stay in a budget-friendly hostel near the city centre.

I'm going to visit the historic centre and Parque de los Novios.

I'm going to spend time at the beach and take sunscreen and water.

I'm going to try Caribbean food at a local restaurant.

04 / 09

Plans for Munich next year:

MUNICH · GERMANY

I'm going to travel to Munich, Germany, next year for the beer festival.

I'm going to stay in a hotel near the Theresienwiese (the festival ground).

I'm going to visit Marienplatz and explore the old town.

I'm going to walk along the English Garden and visit a museum.

I'm going to try German food and learn useful travel phrases.
